findings.evidence: Financial income data (transaction amounts, descriptions, categories, receipt totals) is stored exclusively in local Dexie/IndexedDB. The only data egress is user-initiated: sharing via mailto: or wa.me links triggered by explicit user action in DocumentShareModal/useDocumentActions. No background network transmission, no third-party SDKs, no analytics telemetry. The 'income' pattern in built JS files corresponds to local-only UI rendering of user-entered financial data.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Financial data remains local-only. Ensure Play Store Data Safety form accurately reflects that no financial info is transmitted off-device in background.
findings.purpose: Local functionality only (financial record-keeping and document generation)

findings.evidence: No photo collection or transmission found. The only image handling is: (1) company logo upload via file input read as data URL and stored in local Dexie, (2) non-functional receipt scanner input (accept='image/*') that does nothing with the file, and (3) html2canvas DOM capture for local PDF generation. The 'image/*' pattern in vendor-pdf matches jsPDF library internals, not user photos. No photo gallery access, no camera upload, no photo transmission to any server.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. No photos are collected or transmitted. Ensure Play Store Data Safety form accurately reflects no photo access.
findings.purpose: Local functionality only (not collected or transmitted)
